# Arjanmal Attarchand (Since 1904)

> India's premier heritage manufacturer, wholesale supplier, and exporter of glass perfume bottles, luxury attar decanters, pure aluminium containers, and fragrance packaging. Located in the historic Tilak Bazar, Khari Baoli, Delhi NCR.

## Quick Facts & Business Entity
- **Company Name**: Arjanmal Attarchand
- **Established**: 1904 (120+ years in fragrance and bottle packaging)
- **Headquarters & Showroom**: 772, Tilak Bazar, Khari Baoli, New Delhi, Delhi 110006, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 98115 55255
- **Website**: https://arjanmalattarchand.com
- **Business Type**: Manufacturer, Bulk Wholesaler & Exporter
- **Coverage**: Pan-India shipping and Global International Export

## Core Product Categories & Specifications

### 1. Luxury Attar & Ittar Decanter Bottles
- **Capacities**: 150ml, 250ml
- **Materials**: High-clarity heavy crystal-cut glass with electroplated gold casing, gold screen-printed arabesque filigree, and ornamental glass/gold stoppers.
- **Applications**: Premium Oud display, luxury Ittar decanting, wedding & festive gift packaging.
- **Packaging**: Wholesale master carton packing (24 to 40 pieces per carton).

### 2. Pure Aluminium Bottles & Canisters
- **Capacities**: 50ml, 100ml, 250ml, 500ml, 1000ml (1 kg)
- **Materials**: 100% pure seamless industrial-grade aluminium with protective inner epoxy lacquer lining.
- **Closure**: Leak-proof inner plug with tamper-evident screw cap.
- **Applications**: Essential oils, bulk attar compounds, aroma chemicals, pharmaceutical and cosmetic liquids.

### 3. Glass Perfume Bottles & Spray Vials
- **Capacities**: 30ml, 50ml, 100ml
- **Neck Types**: Screw neck, crimp neck with fine-mist gold and silver spray pumps.
- **Glass Types**: Clear flint glass, frosted, and amber UV-protective glass.

### 4. Traditional Ittar Roll-On Bottles
- **Capacities**: 3ml, 6ml, 12ml, 24ml
- **Features**: Stainless steel and plastic roller balls, airtight screw caps in gold, silver, and black.

### 5. Glass Food & Pharma Jars
- **Types**: Amber glass jars, clear cylindrical jars, cuboid jars with airtight lug and screw caps.
